evidence: This is a primary finding stated in the abstract, supported by experimental data.

claim: Transcriptomic changes after injury indicate inflammation and metabolic stress.
source: Moreover, applying a cold-protective treatment, inspired by our previous hibernation research, enables us to deliver deep hypothermia (4 °C) locally to mitigate inflammation and metabolic stress (indicated by the transcriptomic changes after injury) without cold-induced cellular damage, and confers prominent neuroprotection both structurally and functionally.

evidence: This is a primary finding stated in the abstract.

claim: Neither hypothermia treatment alone nor cold protection alone was effective.
